Module net.automatalib.util
Package net.automatalib.util.automaton.conformance

Class KWayTransitionCoverTestsIterator<S,I>

java.lang.Object
net.automatalib.util.automaton.conformance.KWayTransitionCoverTestsIterator<S,I>
Type Parameters:
S - automaton state type
I - input symbol type
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterator<Word<I>>
public class KWayTransitionCoverTestsIterator<S,I> extends Object implements Iterator<Word<I>>
A randomized transition cover test generator based on the concepts of mutation testing as described in the paper Learning from Faults: Mutation Testing in Active Automata Learning by Bernhard K. Aichernig and Martin Tappler.

This iterator selects test cases based on k-way transitions coverage. It does that by generating random test words and finding the smallest subset with the highest coverage. In other words, this iterator generates test words by running random paths that cover all pairwise / k-way transitions.

Implementation detail: Note that this test generator heavily relies on the sampling of states. If the given automaton has very few or very many states, the number of generated test cases may be very low or high, respectively. As a result, it may be advisable to combine this generator with other generators or limit the number of generated test cases.

      Constructor.
      Parameters:
      automaton - the automaton for which to generate test cases
      inputs - the inputs to consider for test case generation
      random - the random number generator to use
      randomWalkLen - the number of steps that are appended to prefix-generated paths
      numGeneratePaths - number of randomly-generated tests used to find the optimal subset
      maxPathLen - the maximum step size of randomly-generated paths
      maxNumberOfSteps - threshold for the number of steps after which no more new test words will be generated (a value less than zero means no limit)
      k - k value used for K-Way transitions, i.e.,the number of steps between the start and the end of a transition
      optimizationMetric - the metric after which test cases are minimized
      generationMethod - defines how the tests are generated
